title: The weekly check-in, <piv>finally in one place.</piv>
withoutBody: A photo in chat, weight in a form, notes in your head, feedback in a voice note.

submit.p: Weight, energy, sleep, photos and notes — in a guided two-minute form.

context.p: Their weight trend, adherence and last check-in sit right beside it.

review.p: Read it once, with the full picture — not across four apps.

respond.p: Reply and adjust the plan from the same screen.
